# EnergyGrid local run monitor
- Alerts only for what the EnergyGrid daily native task (11:30 SGT) cannot report itself: no completed run report by 14:00 SGT (task missed, crashed, report withheld or refused), or a bill still PENDING after a finished run.
- Bill success and failure emails stay with the EnergyGrid Core (single sender). Reported FAILURE streams are recorded here, never re-sent.
- Reports come only from egmonitor.cmd after the daily run, with the X-EnergyGrid-Monitor-Key header.
- Alerts are emailed through the shared XB Ops Alert Email workflow (system ENERGYGRID), one call per alert, no retry. Remove Duplicates allows one attempt per incident.
- PC shut down / n8n stopped: intentionally no alert.
- ENABLE_OWNER_ALERTS stays false in this source export; it is set true only on the qualified live copy.

## Required manual configuration:

- **Send Owner Alert Email**
  - `Workflow ID`: the live XB Ops Alert Email workflow.
